title: Two-Time-Scale Coordination of Vehicle-to-Grid Voltage Support and Frequency Reserve in a Two-Area System Using Proximal Policy Optimization: code, trained policies and data
description: Simulation environment (IEEE 33-bus AC power flow per area, two-area load-frequency control with V2G droop, energy-consistent EV fleet), PPO training and evaluation scripts, trained policies, raw evaluation records, verification suite, and the LaTeX source of the manuscript. See README.md and REPRODUCE.md.
